Cue.name: Read me
Cue.notes: Two process cues: each runs a Pure Data patch from its GO until Esc. Pick one to see its patch at the foot; GO, and the values show on it as they go by. Sensor to cues hears a light sensor at /sensor on this machine and fires the two cues in Fired by patches; Slider to desk is played on the canvas with Ctrl+E and writes to a desk listening on port 9000. The go. boxes are Go.dot's ready-made patches: open one in Pd or plugdata for its help.

Process.name: Sensor to cues
Slider to desk
